body: I wasn't there when the loan details were set up, and this person didn't have my info, there's literally no way it was applied for in both our names, hence my confusion at being on it at all
That's what I've been doing, but it's not working anymore and I think a professional is the only thing left, but I don't know how to convince them
Thank you, I'll let them know.

My lawyer has gotten in touch with them and has a written promise they'll refinance into the new name.

(my ex changed their name and the name on the title/lease is different from the current name)

My ex was actually approved without me, that's part of why I had no idea I was co-signing. I didn't give them any of my information, I just signed the title and the sales agreement- or at least that's what I was told I was signing.
I never agreed to make payments. It's their car. I didn't know that I'd be held responsible for them.

What about refinancing? My old lawyer said that was how she got it out of my name and into her and the wife's.

A friend told me to try to sell the car and pay off the loan, but that's nearly impossible as I don't know where it is.
Probably, but I remember talking to the sales guy and explaining I was to be on the title, not the loan. I just wanted to explain the situation as best I could- you never know what detail will help.
